The '''2024–25 Linafoot''' is the 64th season of the [[Linafoot]], the top-tier [[association football|football]] league in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], since its establishment in 1958.<ref>{{Cite web|title=LINAFOOT.com|url=https://linafoot.com/|access-date=2022-02-23|website=linafoot.com}}</ref>

[[TP Mazembe]] are the defending champions.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://lequotidien.sn/rdc-officiellement-champion-saison-2023-2024-et-de-20-pour-le-tp-mazembe/|title=RDC – Officiellement champion saison 2023-2024 : Et de 20 pour le Tp Mazembe !|work=[[Le Quotidien (Senegal)|Le Quotidien]]|date=29 May 2024|access-date=13 September 2024}}</ref> Mazembe drew an average home league attendance of 10,471 in the 2024–25 Linafoot edition, the highest in the league.
